caption:
UWS Briefly · Oct 22–28

• Wegmans confirmed it's opening at 1932 Broadway. The sign went up in June 2024. It's still getting permits.
• A 39-year-old woman was sexually assaulted at knifepoint in Central Park near 66th and Fifth on Saturday night. Police released a photo.
• An NYPD officer's lawsuit accuses her former captain at the Columbus Circle transit district of harassment.
• The Health Department shut Empire Szechuan Kyoto at 193 Columbus.
• The Apthorp's board wants to foreclose on an apartment listed for nearly $50 million. It says the owner owes $928,000 in fees.
• A firefighter was hurt in a 10th-floor apartment fire on Monday morning.
• A car went through the fence at the 72nd Street station early Monday. The driver left it there.
• Trek's bike shop at 156 W. 72nd closes Nov. 7. Cold Stone is coming to 2303 Broadway, if that helps.

Links to every story are in our bio.
Reporting by West Side Rag, I Love the Upper West Side.
